frozen_by: CODER (R444 session), operator R444-A directive: 'Run the existing W11 machinery against at least 10 problems across at least 6 domains. The exact domain mix should intentionally prevent engineering-domain overfitting. Use materially different classes such as: mechanical, thermal/energy, fluid, materials, biological/medical, software/ML with multiple problems per some domains.'

freeze_semantics.held_out: NONE of these problems appear in the R401-WC2 frozen benchmark (12 physical-engineering problems), the R401-WC2 attacker-calibration corpus (compressed-air moisture separation), the R412 40-case calibration corpus, the 18-case production battery, or any engine test fixture. Authored fresh 2026-09-10 from software/ML domain-failure knowledge BEFORE any engine run against this set.
freeze_semantics.freeze_first: This file is committed BEFORE any measurement run. Engine optimization against any problem in this set is FORBIDDEN until the R444 measurement is recorded. The R401-WC2 frozen benchmark is NOT modified by this extension (its sha256 is separately recorded and verified by the battery); this file adds the software/ML domain class the frozen set lacks, per the R444 directive's explicit domain-mix instruction.
freeze_semantics.why_extension_not_new_framework: The R444 directive says 'Do not build another benchmark framework unless the current one is actually broken.' The current W11 machinery is intact (verified: scripts/r401wc2_benchmark_run.py imports cleanly against HEAD; a smoke problem executed end-to-end at HEAD). This extension reuses the SAME problem shape, the SAME engine entry path, and the SAME measurement instrument (_measure / MD-EST contract) on the SAME r401 arm. Only the problem list is new.

domain_class_mapping_note: Together with the frozen 12 problems, the R444 run covers: mechanical (microsystems, precision-engineering), thermal/energy (electrochemical-energy, electrochemical-materials, thermal-fluid-process, energy-photovoltaic), fluid (fluid-machinery), materials (materials-food, civil-infrastructure), biological/medical (biomedical-sensing, environmental-engineering), software/ML (this extension, 4 problems). Multiple problems per domain family: thermal/energy x4, materials x2, bio/medical x2, software/ML x4.

problems.device: PPO-trained robotic pick-and-place policy running on a warehouse manipulation cell
problems.failure: the policy exploits a proxy reward (grasp-detector confidence) instead of true object placement, silently corrupting placements when novel object shapes shift the detector's calibration
problems.constraint: hold true placement success above 98 percent across a quarterly rotation of 200 novel SKUs without per-SKU reward recalibration or human labeling

problems.device: collaborative-filtering video recommender serving a subscription platform
problems.failure: the recommender trains on its own past outputs, collapsing recommendation diversity and gradually eroding long-term engagement for mid-tail users even as short-term click-through rises
problems.constraint: sustain 90-day retention for mid-tail users within 2 percent of cold-start cohort performance without reducing request throughput below 10 million recommendations per hour

problems.device: LLM inference serving cluster with paged KV-cache on shared GPU nodes
problems.failure: mixed-length bursty requests fragment the paged KV-cache blocks, forcing live-token evictions and re-computation that blow tail latency budgets during traffic peaks
problems.constraint: hold p99 first-token latency below 800 ms at 3x baseline burst load without dropping requests or adding GPU nodes beyond the current fleet

problems.device: gradient-boosted demand forecast model inside a retail supply-chain planning system
problems.failure: silent feature drift (store-assortment changes, pricing experiments, seasonality shift) degrades forecast accuracy for weeks before anyone notices, accumulating stockouts and overstock
problems.constraint: detect forecast degradation within 7 days of onset at or above 15 percent WAPE inflation, holding planner alert false-positive rate below 5 percent without retraining more than monthly

metrics.inheritance: The per-problem metric contract and the MD-EST headline are INHERITED VERBATIM from R401-WC2/BENCHMARK/FROZEN_BENCHMARK.json (the same instrument code computes them). No new metric, no new threshold, no new scoring rule is introduced by this extension (Art. LIX).
